title: Timeouts and 5xx on inventory-service
description: Elevated latency on inventory-service (p95 262ms) with rising errors reported by consumers.
root_cause_detail: Per-request session objects in inventory-service were retained by a global registry, so memory grew with traffic.
expected_symptoms: inventory-service memory_usage climbs gradually from ~40% to ~99% over ~62+ minutes
increasing GC / heap pressure logs on inventory-service
inventory-service p95 latency rises from ~32ms to ~262ms as memory grows
inventory-service errors appear late, error rate up to ~13.5%
inventory-service db_connection_utilization stays within normal range
resolution: Restarted the pods, removed the global registry reference and added a heap usage alert.
